{{Top|rwm|can|fotj}} {{TelevisionEpisode |image=[[File:Rising_Malevolence.png]] |title="Rising Malevolence" |series=''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' |season=[[The Clone Wars: Season One|One]]{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode002.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rising ''Malevolence''}} |episode=2 |production=1.07 |screener= |airdate=[[October 3]], [[2008]] |intl release= |runtime=27 minutes |director=[[Dave Filoni]] |writer=*[[Steven Melching]] *[[Henry Gilroy]] {{C|Story Editor}}{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}} |production company= |guests= |canon_timeline=[[22 BBY]]{{TCWcanondates|102}} |legends_timeline=[[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]{{TCWdates|102}} |prev="[[Ambush]]" |next="[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]" }} {{Quote|Belief is not a matter of choice, but of conviction.|Moral|}} "'''Rising ''Malevolence'''''" is the second episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. It is the second episode of the series overall, and is the first of a three-part storyline. It aired on [[Cartoon Network]] on [[October 3]], [[2008]], following the premiere of "[[Ambush]]." ==Official description== ''Creating panic throughout the galaxy, a devastating Separatist mystery weapon terrorizes the clone starfleet. Anakin and Ahsoka race to save Jedi Master Plo Koon and his clone troopers in time. Jedi Master Plo Koon and his squad barely survive an attack from a mysterious Separatist warship called the ''Malevolence''. Can they stay alive long enough for Anakin and Ahsoka to find them?'' ==Opening narration== {{OpeningCrawl |name=Episode 2
RISING MALEVOLENCE |text=The clone star fleet is under siege! Dozens of Republic warships have been destroyed in merciless surprise attacks that leave no survivors. Rumors spread of a terrible new Separatist weapon. In the face of growing fear, the Jedi Council sends Master Plo Koon to hunt down the menace before it strikes again....}} ==Plot summary== {{Quote|This mystery weapon has struck in a dozen systems and disappeared without a trace.|Mace Windu, on the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} strikes|}} Aboard the ''[[Triumphant]]'', [[Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon]] and [[Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe]] have located the ''[[Malevolence]],'' a [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] commanded by [[Grievous|General Grievous]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] leader [[Count]] [[Dooku]], in the [[Abregado system]] and move their fleet of three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] into position to [[Battle of Abregado|engage]] it. Before attacking, Plo advises reporting their position and contacts [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano]], who are stationed in the nearby [[Bith system]]. He tells them he's tracked the Separatist's secret weapon to the Abregado system and requests reinforcements. Anakin says he'll have to first ask the [[Jedi High Council]] as he is under strict orders to protect the staging area. Their communication abruptly fails as the ''Malevolence'' jams the ''Triumphant's'' transmissions. The ''Malevolence''{{'s}} massive [[ion cannon]], the secret weapon, fires, disabling Jedi cruisers, leaving them defenseless against Grievous' [[turbolaser]]s. Plo Koon, along with clone troopers [[Sinker]], [[Boost/Legends|Boost]], and Commander Wolffe, board an [[escape pod]] and manage to launch just before their cruiser is destroyed. Dooku orders Grievous to deploy their [[Droch-class boarding ship|pod hunters]] to find and kill any survivors and keep the ''Malevolence's'' identity a secret. [[File:Malevolence_firing_ion_pulse.png|thumb|right|275px|The ''Malevolence'' fires its ion cannon, destroying Plo Koon's fleet.]] Meanwhile, Anakin and Ahsoka join a holographic conference call with [[Supreme Chancellor|Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]], and Masters [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Mace Windu]], and [[Yoda]]. Anakin informs them of the loss of communication with Plo Koon and the likelihood that Koon's fleet was destroyed. Anakin proposes a rescue mission, but Master Windu tells him that all battle groups, including Anakin's, will be reassigned to defend the supply convoys and that no ships can be spared. Ahsoka protests, believing their could still be survivors. Anakin apologizes for his [[Padawan]]'s outburst and promises to deploy his forces as ordered, then ends the call. Anakin scolds Ahsoka for her insubordination then informs [[Wullf Yularen|Admiral Yularen]] that he and Ahsoka will take the ''[[Twilight]]'' and split from the fleet to scout ahead for enemy activity. Aboard the escape pod, Commander Wolffe informs the others that the pod's power grid is burned out leaving them adrift with no engine, communications, and, soon, no life support. Koon urges them to restore power in anticipation of a rescue. As they conduct repairs, Plo and the clones spot another pod. As it rotates before them, however, adrift in space, they realize it has been broken open and the clones inside killed, suggesting they are not alone in the debris field. Dropping out of hyperspace, Anakin orders [[R2-D2]] to begin scanning for life forms. Before Ahsoka can ask why, she notices they've arrived in the Abregado system. She confronts Anakin on defying the council's orders when she herself was scolded for such a suggestion. Anakin explains it was never his intention to leave anyone behind, and that doing what the council says is one thing, how they do it, another. Continuing with the repairs, the clones manage to get comms working again. They receive a distress signal from another, nearby pod and witness as a pod hunter and its droid crew attack it, break it open, and kill the clones inside. As Anakin and Ahsoka comb the debris field, Ahsoka, growing frustrated, explains why finding Master Koon is so important to her; That he's one of her oldest friends, and that it was he who brought her to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant to begin her Jedi training. R2-D2 alerts them of an incoming transmission and Master Kenobi, having learned from Yularen of Anakin and Ahsoka's truancy, appears on the holoprojector wanting answers. He implores Anakin to rejoin the convoy escort or risk missing the rendezvous with the fleet. Anakin assures him they are on their way and cuts the transmission. Before they can leave, however, R2 informs them that he's picked up something on the emergency channel. The pod hunter crew notices Koon's escape pod. They fly over and latch onto it. Plo orders Wolffe to stay behind and maintain the communications signal while he, Sinker, and Boost exit the pod and engage the enemy. The trio manages to defeat the droid crew and destroy the pod hunter, but losing contact with the hunter signals to Grievous that there are still Republic survivors in the debris field putting up a fight. Guided by the Force, Ahsoka detects Master Koon's presence in the debris field and, taking control of the ''Twilight'', flies to his location. Using the ''Twilight's'' tow cable, Anakin and Ahsoka are able to pull Koon's escape pod safely aboard. A [[2-1B surgical droid]] assesses the clones and stabilizes them, saying they will need a medical frigate for complete recovery. The ''Twilight's'' sensors detect the ''Malevolence's'' approach. Koon, Anakin, and Ahsoka quickly shut down the ''Twilight's'' power system, as well as R2, hoping to avoid detection. They watch anxiously as the ''Malevolence'' arrives and, indeed, seems to move past them, unaware of their presence. Ultimately, however, the ''Malevolence'' picks up a faint signal from the medical droid and the giant ship moves into attack position. [[File:Go_Twilight_Go.png|thumb|left|275px|The ''Twilight'' tries to escape the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} ion cannon.]] Forced to flee, the ''Twilight'' powers up and flies off. The ''Malevolence'' fires its ion cannon. The ''Twilight'' desperately navigates the debris field staying just ahead of the energy surge before finally clearing the field and narrowly escaping by jumping to [[hyperspace]]. Grievous turns to Count Dooku and voices what the [[Sith Lord]] already knows: Now the Republic will learn of the Separatists' ion cannon. Vexed, Dooku walks away, saying he will have to discus this with his [[Darth Sidious|master]]. Back aboard Anakin's fleet, Commander Wolffe thanks Anakin for saving them. Anakin praises Ahsoka for having never given up, then, with Master Koon and R2-D2, they leave to report to the Jedi Council and to inform them of the secret weapon. ==Continuity== The scene containing the dialogue and firing sequence for the ''Malevolence'' is extremely similar to, and a direct reference of, the first [[Death Star]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope]]. The second escape pod, [[Pod 1977/Legends|Pod 1977]], is named after the release year of the original [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'']]. [[Boost/Legends|Boost]] and [[Sinker/Legends|Sinker's]] attempt to restart the escape pod's power grid uses dialogue directly lifted from [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']] when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] are trying to fix the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. ==Media==
